name: nexus
description: Nexus — open-source, multi-tenant GitHub commit scheduler. Next.js app on Netlify. Isolated per-user commit engine.

scripts.test:all: node test_file_update.js && node tests/run_all.js && node test_adversarial_m1.js
scripts.ci:check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.release: npm run build && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push origin --tags
